contact.developerDescription:
Leiksvæði is a community project designed to help families discover and share amazing playgrounds across the country.
Our goal is to map all playgrounds in Iceland and make information about them accessible to everyone – whether you're looking for small neighborhood playgrounds or large outdoor areas with diverse equipment.

We collect information about location, equipment, accessibility, and quality of play areas, making it easier to find safe and fun playgrounds suitable for children of all ages.
You can help! By sharing photos, reviews, and suggestions, we improve the database together and make playgrounds more visible and better for everyone.

Your feedback matters – thank you for participating!
